title: Smallness of sections of a locally generated fppf sheaf
statement: Fix a universe u and a scheme S [def-pc-scheme]. Let P be a Type u-valued presheaf on the big fppf site over S [def-pc-fppf-site], Q a Type (u+1)-valued sheaf on that site, and η : ULift(P) → Q a locally surjective natural transformation. Then Q(T) is u-small for every S-scheme T. No quasi-compactness or finiteness hypothesis is imposed on S or T.

source.place: Tags 00WB and 00WK, local representability of sheafification; size refinement using Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/FiniteType.lean, essentiallySmall_costructuredArrow_Spec

proof.text: For a small-valued presheaf P and a large-valued fppf sheaf Q locally generated by ULift(P), prove that Q has small sections. For a fixed test scheme T, Mathlib essentiallySmall_costructuredArrow_Spec gives a small model of affine schemes locally of finite type over T. Encode x in Q(T) by the set of all pairs (V,p) in that model whose P-representative maps to the restriction of x. Local surjectivity of η gives an fppf cover on which x has representatives; refine it by affine open covers. Each refined member is affine locally of finite type over T, hence represented in the small model. Equality of the encodings therefore gives equality of x and y on this cover; sheaf separatedness gives x=y. Thus the encoding is injective into a small power set.

theorem fppf_small_of_local_representatives {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (Q : Sheaf (fppfTopology.over S) (Type (u + 1)))
    (η : P ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1} ⟶ Q.obj)
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (fppfTopology.over S) η] (T : Over S) :
    Small.{u} (Q.obj.obj (op T))
